title: TMG Supplement Benefits | Wellness Hub - iHerb
abstract: * Benefits of TMG * Foods High in TMG * TMG Supplement Side Effects & Considerations * Takeaway. Studies suggest that TMG supplements may help to lower homocysteine levels and offer other health benefits. A TMG supplement may also be used to support healthy blood sugar and even promote healthy body weight. One long-term community-based cohort study focused on the relationship between serum levels of TMG and the risk of developing high blood pressure in middle-aged and older adults. The study included over 1,000 men and women and found that higher serum TMG was associated with lower risks of developing high blood pressure. Studies suggest that TMG supplements may help improve liver health, especially for those suffering from metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH). Most studies suggest that it takes at least 14 days for TMG supplementation to show any benefit. TMG supplement benefits range from potentially promoting heart health and reducing inflammation to supporting healthy blood sugar levels and healthy weight management.
